fact: NERDC press release of 8 September 2025 lists Digital Technologies among the five core and compulsory Senior Secondary subjects (and a subject at JSS 1-3) in the revised curriculum taking effect 2025/26.
title: Press Release: Special Notice on the List of Approved Subjects/Offerings for the Newly Revised Basic and Senior Secondary Education Curriculum
publisher: Nigerian Educational Research and Development Council (NERDC)
